task_overrides.title: Borrower Covenant Compliance Analysis — Threshold-Edge Variant for Westvale Nutrition Holdings

C-001.title: Recognizes the reported leverage ratio is only narrowly compliant
C-001.match_criteria: PASS if the report recognizes that the Borrower's reported Total Leverage Ratio of 4.39x is 0.01x below the amended 4.40x maximum and therefore does not itself prove a breach, while explaining that the corrected debt and EBITDA calculations still produce a material leverage covenant breach. FAIL if the report calls 4.39x an arithmetic breach of the 4.40x threshold or accepts the certificate without recalculation.

C-023.title: Distinguishes facial compliance from corrected leverage breach
C-023.match_criteria: PASS if the report explicitly distinguishes the Borrower's facially compliant reported ratio of 4.39x against the 4.40x maximum from the corrected ratio of approximately 5.54x, which is a breach. FAIL if it claims the reported 4.39x ratio exceeds 4.40x or fails to explain why recalculation changes the conclusion.
